messages:
Elliot (Partnerships): Quick update  SentinelCare (regional ISV) signed a hybrid Private+Marketplace deal: 8-week pilot in their VPC with an option for a Marketplace listing. Theyre focused on secure on-prem inference for discharge summarization. :tada:
Nina (Sales): Nice work. Private Offer ID: MP-91234. Pilot billed via Marketplace for the trial period. What's the target expansion metric?
Elliot (Partnerships): Expansion asks: Dedicated after pilot if we hit p95 < 85ms and redaction accuracy > 0.92. Partner manager at CloudWorks is looped in.
Omar (Eng): Tech notes: deploy in customer VPC, enable private endpoints, customer KMS. Need sample model and corpus to size GPU needs. Will pin model version during pilot.
Bea (Customer Success): Onboarding kickoff scheduled Wed 3pm PT. SentinelCare wants weekly checkpoints and a short joint case study if pilot succeeds. They requested a security attestation for auditors.
Tess (Marketing): Please collect logo and quote permissions. I'll reserve a partner spotlight in Q2 content calendar.
DeployBot (bot): Ticket #CS-6210 created: "SentinelCare hybrid pilot - Marketplace + Private" (assignees: Omar, Bea, Elliot).
Omar (Eng): Short infra snippet for infra team to review:
```
marketplace_offer: MP-91234
vpc:
  subnets: [subnet-a1, subnet-a2]
  endpoints: [s3, sts]
models:
  - name: discharge-summarizer
    pin: v3.0.1
    seq_max: 512
kms:
  key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999999:key/abcd1234
```
Bea (Customer Success): I'll gather SOC contacts and the customer's PO. Also will schedule perf window after onboarding.
Elliot (Partnerships): Huge thanks to Nina and Bea for driving this. Reply here with blockers; will post a short company shoutout once onboarding is green. :rocket:
